subject: RBC Wealth Management
problem: Financial advisors were spending over an hour manually gathering and synthesizing CRM data to prepare for individual client meetings.
workflow: The AI agent accesses the advisor's Salesforce CRM data in real-time, autonomously synthesizing relevant client information, account history, and market context into a pre-meeting briefing.
result: Meeting preparation time was reduced from more than one hour to less than one minute per client.
result_basis: Vendor-reported case study; referenced in Salesforce Agentforce ecosystem documentation.
measurement_context: A direct comparison of time-to-task completion for a high-volume, repeatable workflow (meeting prep).
source_quote: Meeting prep that once took more than an hour now takes less than a minute.
limitation: The accuracy of the briefing depends entirely on the quality and cleanliness of the underlying CRM data accessed by the agent.
listener_action: Measure the time your team spends preparing for standard recurring meetings and trial an automated briefing agent to see if it provides equivalent context.
availability: Available as a standard job-ready agent within the Salesforce Agentforce platform.
